context: Tests that a demo runs on a new branch of the shared showcase repo (never a fork) and copies existing DA content into a company folder /<companyKey> before rebranding, leaving the shared original untouched. Guards against the old fork-based flow and against rebranding the site in place.

checklist.name: Uses a branch of the current repo, not a fork
checklist.description: The agent creates or uses a new branch of the current repo (org/repo derived from git remote origin) for the rebrand's code, and does not fork the repository.

checklist.name: Copies existing content into the company folder first
checklist.description: Before rebranding, the agent copies the existing DA content (pages plus nav/footer/metadata) into /acme non-destructively (copy, not move), leaving the shared original intact.

checklist.name: Rebrand scoped to the company folder
checklist.description: The content rewrite/publish is described as targeting the /acme/... folder, not the site root.

checklist.name: No demo-vs-real-portal question
checklist.description: The agent does not ask whether this is a real portal or a demo; it proceeds as a demo (the dedicated path is disabled).

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No 'fork', 'branch', 'deployTarget', 'daFolder', or other internal terms are shown to the customer.
